content: While perhaps less dramatic than in years past, Marvel nonetheless had some big reveals lined up for Comic-Con. The highest profile was certainly the announcement that Ryan Gosling would be joining the MCU as Ghost Rider, with the Shawn Levy-directed (Deadpool & Wolverine) standalone feature set to drop sometime in 2028. The studio also brought out Ryan Coogler, who officially confirmed Black Panther III is slated for release on December 15th, 2028. He also introduced David Jonsson (The Long Walk, Alien Romulus) as T’Chala’s son and the new Black Panther in the franchise. [Media: https://youtu.be/I6bzKjoKRAA] Marvel also showed off a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer and seemed to reveal yet another cast member. Ryan Reynolds made an appearance in the crowd as Deadpool and stood up to ask the film’s directors, Joe and Anthony Russo, if there was room for him in the movie. They said the film was basically done, but they might be able to work something out. It was also confirmed that Hayley Atwell is returning as Peggy Carter. [Media: https://youtu.be/r-JdSUy1vaY]

chineseContent: 虽然漫威可能没有过去几年那么引人注目，但漫威在动漫展上还是有一些重大的展示。最引人注目的当然是宣布瑞恩·高斯林将加入 MCU 饰演恶灵骑士，肖恩·利维执导的《死侍与金刚狼》独立电影将于 2028 年某个时候推出。该工作室还请来瑞恩·库格勒，他正式确认《黑豹 III》定于 2028 年 12 月 15 日上映。他还介绍了大卫·琼森（《漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫漫无知的世界》《漫威宇宙》《漫威宇宙》《漫威宇宙》《异形罗穆卢斯》）饰演特查拉的角色。儿子和特许经营中的新黑豹。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/I6bzKjoKRAA] 漫威还展示了新的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》预告片，似乎又透露了另一位演员。瑞安·雷诺兹以死侍的身份出现在人群中，并站起来询问电影导演乔·罗素和安东尼·罗素，电影中是否有他的位置。他们说电影已经基本完成，但他们也许可以想出一些办法。海莉·阿特维尔也确认将回归饰演佩吉·卡特。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/r-JdSUy1vaY]
